generation.scope: For every ordered traceless target whose determinant is an integral singular plane cubic, the three-commutator fiber is empty at a nonfree singularity. At a locally free node it consists of four points, two points, or two points plus a smooth affine quadric. At a locally free cusp it consists of two points, the empty set, or a smooth affine quadric. All alternatives occur for every locally free representation class. Explicit adjugate inverses use negative doubling in the generalized Jacobian.

open_mathematics: Treat reduced reducible cubic determinants, starting with a smooth conic and a transverse line. Use component multidegrees of the auxiliary determinantal representation and the two local nodal ranks, then solve the ordered commutator inversion. Keep separate the all-degree AS, full-window coverage, and exceptional fixed-metric obligations.
